characters.description: Cute fully dressed bishoujo SD jiangshi girl; violet ceremonial robe and cap, dark violet hair, paper talisman on forehead, golden sealed fists. Stiff-kneed bouncy hops, straight-arm double-palm impact. Awakened form adds ornate gold seal gauntlets and flowing violet-gold ceremonial sash.

Cute fully dressed bishoujo SD snow spirit; silver sky-blue hair, layered pale blue-white winter kimono and cape, snowflake folding fan. Elegant fan-opening, sleeve sweeps, fan thrust cast. Awakened form adds ice-blue headdress, layered crystalline cape and larger ornate snow fan.

Cute fully dressed bishoujo SD parasol spirit; short chestnut hair, gold-brown traditional dress, large oil-paper umbrella used as a shield. Deliberate planted stance, closed umbrella thrust and opened umbrella guard. Awakened form adds bronze-gold guardian armor and elaborate large paper umbrella canopy.

Cute fully dressed bishoujo SD lotus lantern healer; pale leaf-green hair, cream-green hanbok, held glowing lotus lantern. Gentle held-light idle, graceful lantern raise and outward blessing. Awakened form adds lotus blossom crown, layered ivory-jade robes, ornate lotus lantern.

Cute fully dressed bishoujo SD azure serpent rogue; long teal hair, teal serpent ornaments, covered emerald traditional combat dress and TWO short daggers visibly separated. Low agile stance, opposite-leg steps, forward dagger stab and open-arm follow-through. Awakened form adds emerald-gold serpent diadem, layered scaled sleeves and ornate curved twin daggers.

Cute fully dressed bishoujo SD fire-cart cat spirit; red-brown hair with cat ears, red-black traditional tunic and trousers, small fire-wheel ring held in hands. Nimble catlike stance, wheel wind-up and forward ring cast. Awakened form adds gold flame hairpiece, elaborate scarlet-black robes and a larger crimson-gold wheel.
